name: Patrick James
why: A California chain of men's clothing stores — tailoring, sportswear, shoes — with its own label alongside others.
origin: Founded in Fresno in 1962 by Patrick Mon Pere.

onething.n: verified — own-site collection for the eponymous label. A clothier that sells other people's brands too, so the private label is the only thing that is actually theirs; they call the look West Coast Classic

cities: 9 stores, including Aptos, Carmel, Danville · independent menswear shops, and its own site

craft_evidence.owned_d: About page describes a private-label and brand retailer: 'Patrick James began primarily as a private label store'; merchandise sourced from England, Scotland, USA, Ireland, Italy, France, Germany, Canada and Japan. No factory, workroom or tailor shop named.
